codex-component-ledger-review — V5 APPROVAL CARRIES TO EXACT D2 V6: APPROVE.

Verified plan SHA-256 735e6fdfd033548c480ede4e8a05ef8adb6dd70ee1978cd1abe258fcf2b72874 at 747 lines and unchanged notes SHA-256 4949b0852e1d09fbeaf6f673e05bc51e98bcfab9373fd06a6798ffcf44d89677 at 5447 lines. The two-path diff remains 208 insertions and 21 deletions and diff-check is clean against current main.

The successor claim is byte-proven: replacing only plan line 727 with the exact V5 D2 row reconstructs SHA-256 e132aa3a74a19fe411068c4d45f2d9d9a6fc55e7b1a78d6a41bfbe197753f223, my previously approved V5 plan. Notes are byte-identical to V5. Therefore the sole substantive delta is the revised D2 register row.

That row now accurately summarizes independently present-or-missing signed PTS/DTS, packet-duration-zero unknown semantics, exact rational timebase/origin/epoch/rendition, the audience-facing edition playback axis, canonical directed family/occurrence/seam relation identity distinct from derivation receipt, exact or typed quantized/enclosing/refused projection, conditional set-valued reverse, and the three noninterchangeable mapping families. It closes the scout register mismatch without weakening any V5 law or court.

Provenance note: shared HEAD/main advanced concurrently to c8ffe86ce931b5825271c317cf6bdf12898d10ea, so the V6 request line naming 0b414b4 as current main is stale. The exact artifact hashes, 208/21 two-file diff, and clean diff-check still reproduce against current main, whose intervening commits do not touch this scoped delta. My approval remains documentation-only pre-C1 and grants no runtime or acquisition authority. No file edit was performed.
